profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at PayPal
profile.summary:
Developer with twenty years experience with web applications.  Skilled in MVC frameworks.  Particularly good with user management, database features and implementation of complex and flexible interfaces.

Specialties: software architecture, reverse engineering code, database interface, server management, flexible apis, comprehensive documentation, PHP, Perl, Java, JavaScript, AJAX, MVC,  XML, XSLT, Exist, JQuery, MooTools, Zend Framework, Zend Server, Zend Job Queue, Apache Server, MySql, SQLlite, Oracle.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Work as senior developer on the Account Updater team.  Created systems to keep customer payment information current.  Worked with Ruby on Rails framework.  Documented and led discussions to finalize technical specs for projects.  Onboarded new developers.  Paired with developers for multiple projects.  Acted as subject matter expert for multiple projects.  Gave talks on setup of development environments. Created open source tools for running customized queries.
positions.insights: Skills: Database Administration · PHP · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Unix

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Write AWS Lambda applications using DynamoDB, Aurora, SNS, SQS and Kafka using Node.  Started several efforts including creating an acceptance test framework that was built up to hundreds of tests, made a test framework for a job queuing system and updating the auth framework for the API.  Updated a payment system for PCI compliance.  Made a system for managing kiosk apps using Angular and PHP.  Interviewed applicants for many positions.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description: Worked on custom content management system written in PHP and JavaScript.  Maintained analytics written in JavaScript, C# and Java.  Recommended employees for hiring.  Scheduled meetings, assigned tasks in Jira and trained new employees.  Investigated existing system and wrote documentation for it.  Trained in Hippo CMS and planned next generation architecture.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Expanded and maintained a large, high-volume project in C#.  Created social sign on interfaces with full stack JavaScript, templating and C#.  Documented and diagrammed internal structure of large amounts of code.  Made system that simulated varied and high-level traffic (NFL forums during draft week) using JMeter and Java.  Built Chef servers, wrote and updated Chef recipes in Ruby and integrated servers with TeamCity.  Created system that incorporated geolocation and third party APIs to add value to existing products.

positions.title: Dexter Architect
positions.description: Set up data loading website.  Trained data team.  Created service architecture allowing several systems (PHP, REST, Geaman, command line APIs) to use business logic layer.  Created scheduling and automation system for data import that increased load speed 300%.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description: Created MVC framework, user management, registration system, messaging and relationship management system for front-end website.  Created iCalendar and social network interface.
